explanation: The statement is about the library's own definitions (MetricField, SmoothPositiveOn, iteratedCoordPartial on Coord). It bounds the word-difference of iterated coordinate partials of g_ij and h_ij at a point by the norm of the iterated Fréchet derivative of g_ij - h_ij. The proof uses the library's lemmas norm_iteratedCoordPartial_le_jet and iteratedCoordPartial_sub_actual. Mathlib has nothing about iteratedCoordPartial or metric fields. Its general iteratedFDeriv lemmas don't give this statement without those local definitions, so I found no matching declaration.
